message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming task configs, model paths, or tokenized data anywhere in the visible code.

No detected untrusted source handling: Models and tokenizers are fetched from HuggingFace Hub via AutoModelForPreTraining.from_pretrained and AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained without any checksum verification, pinned revision/commit, or authentication check.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs tokenization, caching, and model export with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via AutoModelForPreTraining.from_pretrained() and AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained() with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; it simply trusts the model name/path as provided.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., Neural Cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or adversarial perturbation methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolated held-out test set explicitly separated from training data at the code level, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code passes task config paths and model names directly to tokenize_and_cache and export_model without any validation or sanitization of inputs before processing.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs such as probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation anywhere in the visible inference pipeline code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a BERT/RoBERTa-style classifier (not a generative LLM), and no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation is implemented.
